title: A Nuclear Spaceship to Mars: NASA's SR-1 Freedom Explained
card_text: NASA is building the first spacecraft that will ride a nuclear fission reactor to another planet. SR-1 Freedom launches for Mars in 2028 — and its design just took a leap forward.

title: Turning Carbon Dioxide Into a Fuel Ingredient — Using Only Light
card_text: Splitting carbon dioxide used to take furnace heat. Rice University scientists just did it with visible light, a copper antenna and an 'oxygen sponge' — turning a pollutant into a product.

title: The Teeth That Rewrote the Story of Homo Erectus
card_text: Nine teeth from two caves in southern China say Homo erectus survived 216,000 years longer than we thought — in tropical rainforest. And one tooth belongs to no one we know.

title: AI Data Centers in Space: The Plan for a Million Satellites
card_text: The FCC has authorized SpaceX to put up to one million AI data-center satellites in orbit. Why data centers are heading to space — and why a million is such a startling number.

title: The Year Clean Energy Passed Coal
card_text: For the first time in history, renewables generated more of the world's electricity than coal — 33.8% to 33.0%. Inside the record year, and the grid challenge that comes next.
